checks.qualification_note: qualified on x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu (a 4-core cloud container, procps-ng 4.0.4) with release-qualify v0.21.68 --skip-remote-check from main 47dd2b300682 as snapshot v0-21-68-rc4; every gate exited 0, 5960 tests passed and 0 failed. The gates ran inside a private network namespace whose only routed interface carried the RFC 1918 address 10.213.7.2, because the host's own address 192.0.2.2 is outside the ranges local_only treats as the local network and tests/host_only_privacy.rs needs one inside them; Git commit signing was off in that namespace, so the tagged commit is unsigned. Earlier attempts found and fixed on main: Linux lint and path failures in the KeePassXC bridge (T-CLAUDECLOUDREL-2), four GMCP tests that closed a Unix socket before the handshake (T-CLAUDECLOUDREL-3, T-CLAUDECLOUDREL-5) and the harness kill_tree signalling every process when a pid began with 1 (T-CLAUDECLOUDREL-4), which stopped the qualifying host twice. Windows x86_64 is not qualified yet
